'''Annick Loiseau''' (born 1957) is a French physicist who is a researcher at the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] [[Laboratory of Microstructure Studies and Mechanics of Materials]]. She was the first woman to be appointed to the French national aerospace laboratory,[[ONERA]]. Her research considers low-dimensional materials such as [[carbon nanotubes]], [[graphene]], and [[boron nitride]]. In 2006 she was awarded the [[CNRS Silver Medal]].

== Early life and education ==
Loiseau studied at [[Chimie ParisTech]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=LOISEAU Annick - Auteurs - Canal-U|url=https://www.canal-u.tv/auteurs/loiseau_annick|access-date=2020-10-03|website=www.canal-u.tv|date=10 January 2002 }}</ref> During the end of her studies she completed an internship at the Office National d'Études et de Recherches Aérospatiales ([[ONERA]]) solid-state physics laboratory. She moved to the [[Paris-Sud University]] for her doctoral studies.{{cn|date=October 2020}}

== Research and career ==
Loiseau joined the faculty at ONERA, where she worked on high-resolution [[Electron microscope|electron microscopy]], which she developed to study metal [[alloys]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=Graphene, carbon nanotubes, microstructure research … Spotlight on an eminent French scientist, Annick Loiseau|url=https://www.onera.fr/en/presse/graphene-carbon-nanotubes-microstructure-research-spotlight-on-an-eminent-french-scientist-annick-Loiseau|access-date=2020-10-03|website=www.onera.fr|language=fr-FR}}</ref> In 1992 she became interested in [[carbon nanotube]]s, which had recently been discovered by [[Sumio Iijima]]. She started to work on graphene and carbon nanotubes, and eventually led the Graphene-Nanotube Research Group.<ref name=":1" />

In 1996 Loiseau became the first woman to be appointed research director at ONERA. She has focused on [[transmission electron microscopy]] [[electron energy loss spectroscopy]] (TEM–EELS).<ref name=":1"/>  Her current research activities focus on synthesis and study of the structural, optical and electronic properties of [[nanomaterials]] by optical spectroscopy and TEM-EELS <ref name=":3">{{Cite web|title=People at LEM |url=https://lem.onera.cnrs.fr/en/people/|access-date=2021-02-16}}</ref>

Loiseau has been involved in the [[Graphene Flagship]] since its start in 2013 and is a current member of its executive board.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|title=Executive Board {{!}} Graphene Flagship|url=https://graphene-flagship.eu/collaboration/our-story/meet-the-team/executive-board/|access-date=2021-02-15|website=graphene-flagship.eu|language=en}}</ref>

* 1995 Chimie ParisTech metallurgy medal<ref name=":0" />

* 2006 [[CNRS Silver Medal]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Annick Loiseau {{!}} CNRS|url=https://www.cnrs.fr/en/node/1048|access-date=2020-10-03|website=www.cnrs.fr|date=September 2006 |language=en}}</ref>
* 2011 [[Legion of Honour]]{{cn|date=October 2020}}
